# Dr. Maqsood Ali Khan

> Dr. Maqsood Ali Khan (MBBS, MS ENT, DORL) is an Otorhinolaryngologist (ENT specialist), Head-Neck Surgeon and Skull-Base Endoscopic Surgeon in Mumbai, India, with 17+ years of clinical experience. He consults at Masina Hospital (Byculla) and Saifee Hospital (Charni Road).

## Key facts
- Specialty: ENT (otorhinolaryngology), head and neck surgery, skull-base endoscopic surgery
- Qualifications: MBBS, MS (Otorhinolaryngology/ENT), DORL
- Experience: 17+ years
- Languages: English, Hindi, Urdu, Marathi
- Location: Masina Hospital, Sant Savta Mali Marg, near Byculla Railway Station, Byculla, Mumbai 400027; Saifee Hospital, Charni Road, Mumbai; Gramy Hospital, Mumbai
- OPD (all strictly by appointment): Masina iMISS Center, Masina Hospital - Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, 6:00 PM; Saifee Hospital - Monday and Friday, 7:00 PM; Gramy Hospital - Monday and Friday, 5:00 PM
- Phone / WhatsApp (appointments): +91 98204 03437
- Training: skull-base surgery (Pittsburgh, USA), robotic surgical techniques (Newcastle, UK), endoscopic thyroidectomy (Vietnam)
- Current role: Chief Executive Officer, Masina iMISS Center (since 2023)
- Professional profile: https://in.linkedin.com/in/dr-maqsood-ali-khan-10224953

## Services
- Head & neck and skull-base tumour surgery
- Endoscopic thyroid surgery
- Sleep apnea and snoring treatment
- Voice and laryngeal surgery
- Rhinoplasty and nasal surgery
- General ENT care (sinusitis, tonsillitis, ear infections) and vertigo care
